lower_p219_right.page_summary_en: A fascicle-nine (officials) half-leaf. The ○擧母藩 marker opens Koromo Domain, which prints five posts — 知事 1, 大參事 2, 權大參事 1, 少參事 3, and 權少參事 whose count is not printed — followed by ten officials named in two registers: Kawanishi Bunpachi, Kawanishi Rokuzō, Tanaka Jishō, Mori Osamu, Kimura Shizumaro, Yamada Yoichirō, Nakagawa Sashichirō, Matsushita Hyōsuke, Ebina Sanpei and Shibata Junpei. The 知事 column carries its count but no name. Koromo's military line, printed after its officials and standing to the right of the next domain's marker, records 兵隊 未詳 — troop numbers not reported. The ○小泉藩 marker then opens Koizumi Domain with 知事 1, 大參事 1 and 權大參事 2; no Koizumi officials are named on this leaf. The printed page number in the bottom margin is 414.

neighbour_domains.evidence: A second maru-marker ○小泉藩 sits at x 874-966, y 1314-1859. To its left stand three office columns — 知事 一人 (x 749-819), 大參事 一人 (x 615-687), 權大參事 二人 (x 480-547) — and nothing is inked further left. The running header 藩制一覽表第九（擧母、小泉） names Koizumi as the second domain of this fascicle-nine opening.

Every printed count reconciles with the names printed under it. 黑石: 大參事 一人 → 1 name; 權大參事 二人 → 2 names; 少參事 一人 → 1 name. 知事 一人 has no name printed, and 權少參事 has 2 names with no count printed — both are as-printed, not misreads. 久留里: 權大參事 六人 → 2 names on the facing leaf + 4 here = 6; 少參事 二人（一人）→ exactly 1 name printed, which is what the parenthetical states.

lower_p202_left.page_summary_en: Fascicle 9 of the Hansei ichiran prints each domain's officer roster, and this half-leaf (book page 381) carries the whole of Kuroishi's alongside the tail of Kururi's and the opening line of Kurobane's. The four name columns at the right edge complete Kururi's six acting senior councillors — two were printed on the facing half-leaf, four here (Terada Chūhei, Hirosawa Kichirō, Murata Sōtarō, Shinozaki Ryūzō) — and are followed by Kururi's junior councillorship, printed 二人（一人）, two posts with only one name given, and its acting junior councillor Masuda Rensō. Kuroishi, opened by the ○黑石藩 marker, records one governor (no name printed), one senior councillor (Sasaki Osamu), two acting senior councillors (Karaushi Kosui and Karaushi Tōri), one junior councillor (Osaka Seiitsu) and two acting junior councillors (Sakaki Shigetoshi and Yamazaki Den), then closes with 兵隊未詳 — its troop strength not recorded. Kurobane's block begins at the far left with its own ○ marker and the bare label 知事, its figures continuing on the following half-leaf.

neighbour_domains.evidence: Bands 1-4 (x2178-2650) stand right of the ○黑石藩 marker at x2039-2126, so they belong to the previous domain. The facing half-leaf lower_p202_right is headed 藩制一覽表第九（久留里）, marked ○久留里藩, paged 三百八十 (380), and its leftmost column is 權大參事　六人 with only two names printed (鶴見一學, 田丸鎌藏); the four names here (寺田疇平, 廣澤吉郎, 村田鎗太郎, 篠崎龍藏) bring that roster to exactly six, and the 少參事 二人（一人）and 權少參事 columns follow in the same domain's block.

○黑羽藩 marker at x1106-1193, y1351-1892; the only element left of it is the bare office label 知事 (x973-1037, y2353-2499), the first line of Kurobane's entry. MASTER places 黒羽藩's military block on lower_p203_R, the next half-leaf, confirming the block continues there.

Ownership decided by edge gaps, not by eye: its left edge is 2px off the 權大參事 column's ink and 14px off the 大參事 column's ink, whereas ordinary inter-column gaps on this leaf run 55-70px. I confirmed the convention on lower_p229_right, where the identical small "一人" hugs the right side of 佐伯's 少參事 三員 column with the same 4px/58px signature. So this gloss annotates 權大參事 二員: two posts on the establishment, one man actually named — which is exactly what the column shows, one name under a count of two.

x865-925 carries the running header 藩制一覽表第九（西條、佐伯）(y1279-1970) and, far below, the printed book page 四百三十三 = 433 (y3125-3370). The header is PROVENANCE and names both domains on the leaf.

ARITHMETIC / CROSS-CHECK. 西條's fascicle-9 line 兵五小隊 貳百三十七人 reconciles exactly with MASTER's fascicle-6 breakdown for the same domain (lower p51 R): 兵隊 二小隊 八十五人 + 兵卒部 一小隊 四十六人 + 軽卒部 二小隊 百六人 = 5 platoons and 85+46+106 = 237 persons. Independent confirmation of both the platoon count and the headcount. 西條's councillor establishment is 1+3+1+2 = 7 posts under the 知事. No 男/女 splits, no 合高, no other totals to net on this leaf.

MASTER DISAGREES WITH THE SCAN, and the scan wins. MASTER lists exactly one row for lower_p228_left — 佐伯藩 兵隊 步兵二小隊 人員記セス — and that text is NOT printed anywhere on this leaf. I found it on lower_p229_right (book page 四百三十四, header 藩制一覽表第九（三田、鯖江）), where 佐伯's block continues to the right of ○三田藩 with 少參事 三員 (plus the same 一人 gloss), 權少參事 二人, and then 步兵二小隊 人員記セス. So MASTER's single row for this page is mis-paged by one leaf, and MASTER holds no rows at all for the ten 佐土原/西條 items printed here.

PRIMARY DOMAIN. Element counts tie at seven boxes each (西條: marker + 知事 + four councillor columns + troops; 佐伯: marker + 知事 + two councillor columns + two name columns + the gloss). I set 西條藩 as primary because its entire fascicle-9 record — marker, full slate of offices, troop strength — is contained on this leaf, whereas 佐伯's entry only begins here and runs on to lower_p229_right, and because the header prints 西條 first in reading order.

GEOMETRY. All 19 boxes measured by ink projection (threshold px<120) inside per-element windows, padded 10px and then clamped at the midpoint of the ink gap where padding would collide — only the 權大參事 / 一人 pair needed clamping (1px true gap). Programmatic pairwise overlap test: none. Per-box interior padding report: every side 0-17px, no glyph touching or crossing an edge. One overlay rendered to _final.png and read back; no box clips a glyph, sits on whitespace, or overlaps a neighbour, so no second geometry pass was needed. The faint grey vertical text in the lower middle of the leaf is facing-page bleed-through (much lighter ink) and is deliberately not boxed; likewise the binding-edge black at x<420.

lower_p228_left.page_summary_en: Book page 433 of fascicle 9 of the Hansei ichiran, the Dajōkan's 1869-70 survey of the domains, carrying the officials-and-troops entries for three domains in succession. The leaf opens with the tail of Sadowara domain's military return — one artillery company, four field guns and four mortars — then the maru-marker for Saijō domain (Iyo), whose full slate is printed here: a governor, one senior councillor, three acting senior councillors, one junior councillor and two acting junior councillors, with troops of five platoons totalling 237 men. That troop figure reconciles exactly with the fascicle-6 breakdown recorded elsewhere in the survey for the same domain (2 platoons/85 men + 1 platoon/46 men + 2 platoons/106 men). The Saeki domain (Bungo) marker follows, and its entry begins with a governor, one senior councillor (Sakuma Gi'emon) and two acting senior councillorships filled by a single named man, Hazama Shichirōemon, the shortfall recorded in a small interlinear gloss reading 一人.

○佐伯藩 marker at x1382-1467; everything to its left on this leaf — 知事, 大參事 一員 with 佐久間儀右衞門, 權大參事 二員 with 間七郎右衞門 and the small 一人 gloss — is Saeki's. Its entry continues onto lower_p229_right (book page 四百三十四) with 少參事 三員, 權少參事 二人 and 步兵二小隊 人員記セス.

lower_p031_left.reasoning:
SETUP. Native scan 3094x4489. Ink-projection over y=850-3400 finds exactly 14 inked column runs plus the bottom-margin page number: x=934-1017 (running header + page number stacked), 1080-1155, 1204-1284, 1356-1418, 1461-1545, 1592-1676, 1729-1809, 1858-1950, 1991-2077, 2124-2218, 2264-2344, 2384-2476, 2482-2530 (a narrow small-type shoulder note), 2527-2617, 2656-2743. Everything else on the leaf is blank paper, faint facing-page bleed-through (the grey speckle around x=1450-1560, y=2000-2600, much lighter ink, NOT boxed), or binding/scan-frame black.

MARKERS AND OWNERSHIP. There is exactly ONE circle on the page, at x=2411-2477, y=1010-1060, and it is followed immediately by the field label 合高, not by a domain name + 藩. It is therefore a bullet on a total line, the same use as the ○合 bullets on the facing right-hand leaf (pdf p.31 R, printed p.38), and NOT a maru domain-marker. No domain name is printed anywhere on this leaf. The right-to-left rule consequently has nothing to divide here: the whole leaf sits inside a single domain block. That block is 足守藩, which opens with ○足守藩 on pdf p.30 L and runs through p.33 R before ○赤穂藩 opens on p.33 L. The running header at x=958-1017 reads 藩制一覽表第六（足守）, agreeing with the data for once. owner_domain_jp = 足守藩 on every box.

COLUMN WALK, RIGHT TO LEFT.
(1) x=2656-2743, y=1258-2491: 永四百六十壹貫二百八十五文五分. Unlabelled, because it is the tail of a value begun on the facing leaf: p.31 R ends with 五ヶ年平均／正租／現米千八百八拾石壹斗二升八合四勺 for the domain's 岩代國信夫郡 holding, and this is that land tax's cash half. 461.2855 kanmon.
(2) x=2527-2617, y=1005-2322: label 雜税 (y1005-1149) over 永六拾七貫四百七拾四文六分 (y1257-2322). Same Iwashiro block. Single-character zoom at 4x on the final glyph shows 六 with its clear top lid, not 八 and not 九. 67.4746 kanmon.
(3) x=2482-2530, y=1077-1191: small-type 兩國, sitting on the top-right shoulder of the next column. A qualifier, not data.
(4) x=2400-2477, y=1010-2744: ○合高四萬七千九百三十七石九斗一升五合五勺 = 47,937.9155 koku, read with the shoulder note as 兩國合高, the two provinces' combined assessed yield. Sub-units descend 斗>升>合>勺 correctly; the closing glyph zoomed at 2x is 勺, not 才.
(5) x=2264-2344, y=1007-1654: heading 兩國合五ヶ年平均, "both provinces combined, five-year average". It governs the four columns to its left.
(6) x=2124-2218, y=1008-2577: 正租 over 現米壹萬六十二石三斗二升八合二勺 = 10,062.3282 koku. The 十 after 萬 is a plain cross, not 千 — and the arithmetic settles it independently (see below).
(7) x=1991-2077, y=1256-2489: 永四百六十壹貫二百八十五文五分 = 461.2855 kanmon, the cash half of that same 正租.
(8) x=1858-1950, y=1005-2404: 雜税 over 現米壹石六斗九升七合七勺五才 = 1.69775 koku.
(9) x=1729-1809, y=1259-2190: one continuous eleven-glyph run 金百七拾三兩永八拾四文. Glyph pitch is 84.6px and the projection runs put the join between 兩 (ends y1732) and 永 (starts y1762), so I split it into two boxes at y~1747: 金百七拾三兩 = 173 ryo, 永八拾四文 = 84 mon.
(10) x=1592-1676, y=1260-2323: 永六拾七貫四百七拾四文九分. Zoomed at 4x the last glyph is unmistakably 九 (rounded bending leg), against the unmistakable 六 in column (2). 67.4749 kanmon.
(11) x=1461-1545, y=1010-1655: label 兩國正租幷雜税米, no figure beneath it.
(12) x=1356-1418, y=1013-1154: 惣計, in a narrower column (63px vs ~85px elsewhere) and smaller type. It is a "grand total" qualifier printed between the label in (11) and that label's figure in (13).
(13) x=1204-1284, y=1092-2325: 高一萬六十四石二升五合九勺五才 = 10,064.02595 koku.
(14) x=1080-1155, y=1000-1571: label 兩國正税雜税金, and a row projection down the full leaf confirms NOTHING is printed beneath it — the column is empty from y1571 to the bottom margin.
(15) Header x=958-1017, y=1264-1820: 藩制一覽表第六（足守）. (16) Bottom margin x=933-987, y=3074-3245: 三十九, printed page 39 (the facing leaf carries 三十八).

ARITHMETIC NET — all three checks close.
(a) Both-provinces land tax in rice: 8,182.1998 (Bitchu, p.38) + 1,880.1284 (Iwashiro, p.38) = 10,062.3282, exactly column (6). This also proves the disputed 十 is ten, not one thousand.
(b) Grand total in rice: 10,062.3282 + 1.69775 = 10,064.02595, exactly column (13). So columns (11), (12) and (13) read together as one statement, and 惣計 is a qualifier rather than a group heading.
(c) Grand total in cash: 461.2855 + 67.4746 + 173 + 0.084 = 701.8441 ryo (1 kanmon of 永 = 1 ryo). I opened pdf p.32 R to check, and its first column reads 惣計 金七百壹兩三分壹朱永三十壹文六分 = 701 + 13/16 + 0.0316 = 701.8441. Exact.

TWO FINDINGS WORTH RECORDING. First, check (c) closes only with 67.4746; column (10), the both-provinces total, prints 九分 where its single component in column (2) prints 六分. Both glyphs were read at 4x in isolation and they are different characters, so this is a 0.3-mon slip in the printed source, not a transcription error. I record 九分 verbatim and flag it. Second, MASTER's sole row for this leaf, 惣計 金 七百壹兩三分壹朱, is NOT printed on this leaf: only the label 兩國正税雜税金 is here, and the figure sits on the next leaf. The row is a label-here / figure-there split, so nothing on this page contradicts MASTER, but the figure should be attributed to pdf p.32 R.

ONE UNRECONCILED FIGURE. 兩國合高 47,937.9155 does not close against MASTER's p.30 L figures: 30,898.689 (合) + 5,890.88 (外 改高新田) + 11,149.255 (the Iwashiro ○合 on p.31 R) = 47,938.824, a gap of 0.9085 koku. I re-read the whole value at 1.3x and the closing sub-units at 2x and stand by 四萬七千九百三十七石九斗一升五合五勺, so the discrepancy lies in one of the neighbouring leaves' transcriptions rather than here. Flagging it for whoever annotates pdf p.30 L. Separately, 19,749.4335 (the ○合 opening p.31 R) + 11,149.255 = 30,898.6885, which reproduces MASTER's p.30 L 合 exactly — so that pairing is sound and the missing 0.9085 lies somewhere in the 改高新田 line.

GEOMETRY. Boxes are ink-projection extents padded ~10px. Three places are tight by necessity: the shoulder note 兩國 (ink 2482-2530) is wedged between 合高 (ink ends 2477) and the 雜税/永 column (value ink starts 2527), so its box takes 2479-2529 and the 雜税/永 box starts at 2530, clipping ~3px of the value's left edge. An automated pairwise test reports zero box overlaps. One overlay pass was rendered and read; every box proved flush over its glyphs with no clipping and none sitting on whitespace, so no second corrective pass was needed.

Under the heading "both provinces combined, five-year average" the survey then restates the whole tax take: land tax 10,062.3282 koku of rice plus 461.2855 kanmon, miscellaneous tax 1.69775 koku plus 173 ryo, 84 mon and 67.4749 kanmon. lower_p236_right.reasoning:
FULL-WIDTH INK PROJECTION (x, y300-4200, ink<110) found exactly 16 printed columns plus the binding black at x0-78 and the scan frame at x2636-3095 (neither boxed): 436-523, 576-659, 692-789, 840-924, 974-1062, 1121-1190, 1224-1310, 1354-1451, 1505-1571, 1630-1715, 1752-1848, 1895-1997+2000-2024 (heading plus its marginal marks), 2042-2112, 2162-2242. Separate projections over the heading band (y990-1520), the upper name band (y1960-2620) and the lower name band (y2880-3540) show that headings sit ~13-20 px to the RIGHT of their own name column, so each heading pairs with the name column directly beneath it.

MARU-MARKER. Exactly one: ○三上藩 at x973-1063, y1340-1887 (glyphs verified at 6x: ○, 三, 上, 藩). RIGHT-TO-LEFT RULE: everything at x>1063 is read BEFORE the marker and therefore belongs to the PREVIOUS domain, 峯山藩; everything at x<973 belongs to the marked domain, 三上藩. That puts 兵隊　二小隊 (x1121-1190) on the 峯山 side, matching MASTER's single row for this page and matching the fascicle-8/9 rule that a domain's military prints after its officials and can sit to the right of the next domain's marker.

WALK, RIGHT TO LEFT.
(1) x2162-2242: the hashira — running head 藩制一覽表第九（三上）(y1270-1833) and, lower, the printed leaf number 四百四十八 = 448 (y3113-3358). Page-number arithmetic checks: the preceding half-leaf lower_p235_left prints 四百四十七 (447) and lower_p237_right prints 四百五十 (450), so 448 is right. The running head is PROVENANCE and names only 三上, the domain whose entry OPENS here; the leaf's bulk is 峯山's.
(2) x2042-2112, upper slot only: 柴崎七郎兵衞. No heading above it. The preceding half-leaf (lower_p235_left) heads 峰山藩's 權大參事　二人（五人）— printed 2, editorially corrected to 5 — and lists four names there (今井多門, 高木內藏進, 佐藤榮, 辻八太郎). 柴崎七郎兵衞 is the FIFTH, completing that group; its lower slot is empty because the group ends.
(3) x1929-2025 heading 少參事　二人 with two half-width marks (a マ wedge over a ヽ dot) printed in the right margin beside 二. Cropped side by side against lower_p235_left's 少參事　二人（マヽ）at the same scale, these are the same マヽ ("sic") marks, here without the enclosing parenthesis arcs. The heading is flagged because the printed figure is wrong: SEVEN names stand under it, running column-wise right to left, upper slot then lower slot — 齋藤多仲 / 秋山瀨織 (x1900/1884), 石根源五郎 / 塚田六郎 (x1766/1750), 米澤七郎 / 川口克巳 (x1634/1620), 井田耕造 (x1494, upper only). Same editorial pattern as akita_lower_p220_left (少參事　二人（六人）with six names).
(4) x1385-1452 heading 權少參事, no count printed (313 px tall = 4 glyphs only), with four names: 長谷川久一郎 / 田中小十郎 (x1361/1343), 槇秀尾 / 長谷川薰 (x1225/1213).
(5) x1121-1190: 兵隊　二小隊, y1006-1483. Two companies, no headcount printed — agrees with MASTER exactly.
(6) x973-1063: the ○三上藩 marker.
(7) Left of the marker, 三上藩 opens with four office headings, each with its names in the same column: 大參事 (x854-925) / 粥川小十郎; 權大參事 (x721-789) / 神山雪江 (upper), 塚本九一郎 (lower); 少參事 (x592-660) / 水谷榮三郎; 權少參事 (x454-524) / 餌取傳. None of the four headings prints a person-count (heading heights 229-315 px = 3 or 4 glyphs, no trailing 〇人).

GLYPH CHECKS at 6x, single character: 瀨 and 織 in 秋山瀨織 (糸 radical with 音 over 戈 — not 繼, which would show stacked 幺); 巳 in 川口克巳 (closed top, not 己/已); 六 in 塚田六郎 (top dot + lid, not 八); 十 in 粥川小十郎 and 田中小十郎 (plain cross, no slanted top stroke — not 千); 九 in 塚本九一郎 (rounded bending leg, not 七); 七 in 柴崎七郎兵衞 and 米澤七郎; 八 in 四百四十八 (strokes separate at the top). 槇秀尾 and 餌取傳 confirmed. An isolated ink speck at x1752-1770, y2695-2715 (below 石根源五郎) is a stray mark, not a glyph, and is not boxed; faint facing-page bleed-through on the left third is likewise not boxed.

MASTER CROSS-CHECK. MASTER carries ONE row for this page — 峯山藩 兵隊 二小隊, no headcount — which the scan confirms verbatim. The scan does not contradict MASTER anywhere. But MASTER holds nothing else from this leaf: the twelve 峯山 personal names, the three 峯山 headings, and the entire 三上藩 block (marker, four headings, five names) are absent, and MASTER has no 三上藩 rows at all. So 三上藩 is an un-extracted domain in the dataset, and 26 of the 27 elements here are new.

NAMING. 峯山藩's own name is not printed anywhere on this half-leaf — its marker stands on the preceding leaf, where fascicle 9 prints it ○峰山藩 (with 峰); fascicle 7 (pdf p.75) prints ○峯山藩, which is the MASTER key and the form used for owner_domain_jp here.

GEOMETRY. Each box was cut by ink projection inside a generous window (threshold <115) and padded 10 px. A pairwise overlap test over all 27 boxes reported none. One overlay pass was rendered and read: every box encloses its full glyph run top-to-bottom with no clipping, no dead margin and no box sitting on whitespace, so no corrective second pass was needed.

lower_p236_right.page_summary_en: This fascicle-9 half-leaf, printed page 448, carries the tail of Mineyama Domain's (峯山藩) officials roster and the opening of Mikami Domain's (三上藩), the two separated by the ○三上藩 marker at x973-1063. Twelve Mineyama names stand to the right of that marker: Shibasaki Shichirobē, the fifth acting senior councillor (權大參事) of a group whose heading and first four names print on the preceding leaf; seven junior councillors (少參事) under a heading that prints 二人 with the 1928 editor's マヽ "sic" marks beside the figure; and four acting junior councillors (權少參事) under a heading with no count printed. Mineyama's military line closes its entry with 兵隊　二小隊 — two companies, no headcount given — the one element of this page already held in MASTER. Left of the marker, Mikami's entry opens with one senior councillor (粥川小十郎), two acting senior councillors (神山雪江 and 塚本九一郎), one junior councillor (水谷榮三郎) and one acting junior councillor (餌取傳), none of the four headings carrying a printed person-count.

neighbour_domains.evidence: Everything at x>1063 sits to the right of the ○三上藩 marker (x973-1063) and is therefore read first, belonging to the previous domain: the 少參事 heading at x1929-2025, the 權少參事 heading at x1385-1452, the 兵隊　二小隊 line at x1121-1190, and twelve personal names from x1213 to x2124. The entry continues from lower_p235_left, whose ○峰山藩 marker and 權大參事　二人（五人）heading account for 柴崎七郎兵衞 as that office's fifth holder.

The ○三上藩 marker at xywh=pixel:963,1330,110,567 opens this domain; everything at x<973 lies left of it — four office headings (大參事 x844, 權大參事 x711, 少參事 x582, 權少參事 x444) and five personal names beneath them. The running head 藩制一覽表第九（三上）names this domain as the one whose entry begins on the leaf.

lower_p242_left.reasoning:
RENDER + COLUMN WALK. Native scan 3094x4489; page (non-frame) area x445-3093, y220-4237. One ink-projection over the whole text field returned 14 vertical glyph runs, which I walked RIGHT to LEFT (HI reads right-to-left, top-to-bottom):

C1 x2562-2655 = maru-marker ○弘前藩 (4 glyph runs, y1378-1921).
C2 x2416-2514 = 大參事 / 二人, with 西館融 (upper name register) and 山中純一 (lower register).
C3 x2279-2378 = 權大參事 / 三人, names 杉山龍江 (upper), 大道寺族 (lower).
C4 x2161-2230 = name-only column, 西館孤清 (upper register, no lower name).
C5 x2017-2112 = 少參事 / 四人, names 山野茂樹 (upper), 楠美太素 (lower).
C6 x1885-1967 = name-only column, 佐藤清衞 (upper), 岩淵惟一 (lower).
C7 x1750-1852 = 權少參事 / 四人, names 神東太郎 (upper), 都谷森逸眠 (lower).
C8 x1617-1698 = name-only column, 小山巴 (upper), 櫻庭太次馬 (lower).
C9 x1481-1596 = 兵隊 heading over a two-register warichu: right half 兵士 …人, left half 兵卒 …人.
C10 x1360-1450 = maru-marker ○彦根藩.
C11 x1223-1316 = 大參事 / 一人, name 新野古拙.
C12 x1076-1180 = 權大參事 / 三人, names 木俣幹 (upper), 田中央 (lower).
C13 x961-1032 = name-only column, 西村拾三.
C14 x832-915 = running header 藩制一覧表第九（弘前、彦根） (y1296-1984) and, far below it, the printed page number 四百六十一 (y3139-3378).

DOMAIN BOUNDARY. Two maru-markers. Nothing is printed to the RIGHT of ○弘前藩 (the projection finds no ink beyond x2655 except the scan-edge artifact at x3079-3090), so no previous domain overflows onto this leaf; 弘前藩's block starts here. Everything from ○弘前藩 leftward up to — but not including — ○彦根藩 is 弘前藩: the four councillor grades, all thirteen names, and the 兵隊 group. The 兵隊/兵士/兵卒 column sits immediately to the RIGHT of the ○彦根藩 marker, which by the right-of-marker rule (and the fascicle-8/9 habit of printing a domain's military after its officials) makes it 弘前藩's, not 彦根's. That agrees with MASTER, which files this military row under 弘前藩. Everything LEFT of ○彦根藩 — 大參事 一人 新野古拙, 權大參事 三人 木俣幹/田中央/西村拾三 — is 彦根藩, whose block continues onto the next leaf. The running header and the page number sit in the far-left margin and are page furniture (provenance), not domain data; the header names both domains printed on this leaf.

HEADCOUNT ARITHMETIC. Stated counts 2+3+4+4 = 13. Name boxes: C2 gives 2 (=大參事), C3+C4 give 3 (=權大參事: 杉山龍江, 大道寺族, 西館孤清), C5+C6 give 4 (=少參事: 山野茂樹, 楠美太素, 佐藤清衞, 岩淵惟一), C7+C8 give 4 (=權少參事: 神東太郎, 都谷森逸眠, 小山巴, 櫻庭太次馬). 13 names for 13 posts — the counts and the name columns reconcile exactly, which is what fixes each name to its grade. Hikone: 1 + 3 = 4 names present (新野古拙; 木俣幹, 田中央, 西村拾三) ✓.

MASTER DISAGREEMENT — TRUST THE SCAN. MASTER records 弘前藩 兵備 as 兵士 貳千五百五十七人 (2,557) 兵卒 千四百四十九人. Separate row-projections of the two warichu halves give the right (兵士) half exactly SIX number glyphs (y1587-1978) and the left (兵卒) half SEVEN (y1590-2050). Cropped one glyph at a time at 5x, the 兵士 run is 貳 / 千 / 五 / 十 / 七 / 人 — there is no 百 between 五 and 十. So the page reads 兵士 貳千五十七人 = 2,057, and MASTER's 2,557 carries a phantom 百 (the documented M7 error mode). 兵卒 is confirmed 千四百四十九人 = 1,449 (千/四/百/四/十/九/人, seven glyphs). Total force on the page = 3,506 men.

GLYPH CHECKS at 5-7x, single character: 族 (大道寺族, 方+矢 clear), 眠 (都谷森逸眠, 目+民 — distinct from the 馬 that ends 櫻庭太次馬), 孤 (西館孤清, 子+瓜), 衞 (佐藤清衞, kyujitai), 惟 (岩淵惟一). 參 is printed in the kyujitai form 厽+彡 throughout, so all four office titles are transcribed 參 not 参. The counts 二人/三人/四人 and 一人 were read from a 1.6-2.2x crop of the whole label band; every 人 shows the two strokes touching at the apex (not 八).

BOXES. Each box was measured by thresholding px<120 inside a generous region and taking the tight ink bbox, then padding 9px; label glyphs and their value are enclosed together (e.g. 大參事+二人 in one box), and each personal name is its own box since the upper and lower registers are different men. The 兵士/兵卒 pair share one top at the sub-label row (y1373) and are split at the true ink boundary (兵卒 ink ends x1539, 兵士 ink begins x1541) so they abut without overlapping; the centred 兵隊 heading is a separate box above both. A pairwise test over all 30 boxes reports zero overlaps. One overlay pass was rendered to _final.png and read back: every box encloses its glyphs, none clips a stroke or sits on whitespace. Faint facing-page bleed-through around x1150-1250 in the lower third is correctly left unboxed.

lower_p242_left.page_summary_en: This leaf opens the fascicle-9 entry for Hirosaki domain (Tsugaru, Mutsu) with its councillor establishment and its troop strength. Hirosaki reports 2 senior councillors (大參事), 3 acting senior councillors (權大參事), 4 junior councillors (少參事) and 4 acting junior councillors (權少參事) — thirteen men, each named in the columns printed beneath the counts, among them Nishidate Tōru, Sugiyama Ryūkō, Nishidate Kosei and Kusumi Taiso. Its forces are given in a two-register note under 兵隊 as 2,057 heishi and 1,449 heisotsu, 3,506 men in all. The running-head box and the page-number box share the same column but are separated vertically by 1,135 px.

Shibayama's councillors are given by name with no counts: six provisional senior councillors (Satomi Shōbee, Hamano Hirota, Aoki Shōzō, Akagishi Hyōzō, Aoki Genee, Kawazoe Shōki), six junior councillors (Yamagishi Sazō, Hisamatsu Koyata, Tsuchiya Sō, Satake Yoshiee, Kawazoe Shinhito, Shinomiya Naoyoshi), and two provisional junior councillors (Yamazumi Kayoshi, Kondō Takuma). lower_p237_left.reasoning:
RENDER AND OVERALL SHAPE. Scan is 3094x4489. Ink-projection over the paper interior gives 14 vertical glyph runs between x=835 and x=2674, plus a top "office title" register (y≈1030-1375), three "name" registers, and an outer-margin column at x≈835-932 carrying the running header at top and the printed page number at foot. This is a fascicle-9 (officials) leaf; there is no military section anywhere on it.

MARU-MARKERS AND THE RIGHT-TO-LEFT RULE. Two markers: ○三池藩 at x2448-2539 (y1390-1935) and ○靜岡藩 at x1622-1716 (y1380-1923). Reading right to left: everything RIGHT of ○三池藩 (the single column at x2555-2674: 權少參事 + 石渡森衞 + 尾崎彌一郎) belongs to the PREVIOUS domain. That previous domain is 三草藩 (Mikusa): the facing leaf lower_p237_right carries the running header 藩制一覽表第九（峯岡、三草）and its leftmost column is Mikusa's 少參事 running on to this leaf, so the acting-junior-councillor column here is Mikusa's tail. Between the two markers (x1728-2420) is 三池藩; LEFT of ○靜岡藩 (x838-1598) is 靜岡藩.

BOOK-PAGE ORDER. The bottom margin prints 四百五十一 = 451; the facing right-hand leaf prints 四百五十 = 450, confirming p237_right is read first and this leaf second, and confirming Mikusa spills onto it.

COLUMN-BY-COLUMN WALK, RIGHT TO LEFT.
COL1 x2555-2674 — 三草藩: title 權少參事 (y1049-1371); names 石渡森衞 (y2057-2643) and 尾崎彌一郎 (y2979-3565).
COL2 x2448-2539 — ○三池藩 marker.
COL3 x2304-2420 — 三池藩: title 大小參事 (x2310-2378, y1051-1362) with the count 七人 (x2304-2366, y1451-1690) and, in the gutter immediately right of the figure, a small-type parenthetical at x2369-2420. Zoomed to 9x, the parenthetical row-runs are （ 1451-1468 | one horizontal 1489-1498 | two horizontals 1526-1534 + 1553-1560 | 八 1576-1616 | 人 1626-1668 | ） 1673-1690, i.e. （一二八人）= 128 persons, in the 1928 editor's digit-sequence style.
COL4 x2128-2251 — 大參事; name 屋山外記; second name 庵原覺平.
COL5 x1992-2115 — 權大參事; names 佐野三郎治 and 森脩, with the small rider 公議人 at x2072-2124.
COL6 x1861-1984 — 少參事; names 立花碩 and 吉村土肥.
COL7 x1728-1851 — 權少參事; names 中島裕 and 堀七右衞門.
COL8 x1622-1716 — ○靜岡藩 marker.
COL9 x1515-1598 — 大參事; one name 平岡丹治.
COL10 x1345-1465 — 權大參事; 淺野次郎八, 服部綾雄, 河野九郎.
COL11 x1210-1324 — no title of its own, so it continues 權大參事: 織田泉三, 富永雄造, 戸川平太.
COL12 x1076-1189 — no title, continues 權大參事: 大久保一翁, 山岡鐵太郎, 妻木務, the last carrying the 公議人 rider at x1156-1206.
COL13 x948-1070 — 少參事; 松平寛太郎, 津田眞一郎, 岩田綠堂.
COL14 x835-932 — outer margin: running header 藩制一覽表第九（三池、靜岡）(y1290-1977) and printed page number 四百五十一 (x835-886, y3134-3364).

ARITHMETIC CHECK. Miike's summary line prints 七人 (7 persons) for 大小參事, and exactly seven men are named beneath it across COL4-COL7 (1 + 2 + 2 + 2 = 7). The count reconciles. The small parenthetical （一二八人）= 128 therefore cannot be an editorial correction of the councillor count (the pattern seen elsewhere in this reprint, e.g. 少參事 二人（六人）on lower_p220_left); on the evidence of the page alone its referent is undetermined, and I have recorded it verbatim inside the same box rather than parsing it. The Miike attribution is independently corroborated by one of the named junior councillors, 立花碩: Tachibana is the ruling house of Miike.

RIDER ATTRIBUTION. Both 公議人 riders are set in small type, raised about 130 px above the name register and placed in the gutter to the RIGHT of a name column — the corpus convention (cf. hasunoike_lower_p133_right, "printed to the right of Nagata Yūsuke"). The Miike rider at x2072-2124 therefore labels 森脩 in COL5 (x1992-2068), not 庵原覺平 in COL4 (x2128-2206); the Shizuoka rider at x1156-1206 labels 妻木務 in COL12 (x1076-1149), not 戸川平太 in COL11 (x1210-1279). Horizontal profiles over y2940-3060 confirm the three-way separation on each side: (2006-2068 | 2074-2124 | 2140-2206) and (1091-1149 | 1158-1206 | 1223-1279).

LOOK-ALIKE AND VARIANT CHECKS. COL3's second glyph is 小 (plain three-stroke) not 少 — compared side by side with the 少 of COL6/COL13 in the title register, which carries the extra falling stroke. Single-glyph zooms at 7x settled 寛 (in 松平寛太郎; the 宀 sits directly on the 見-form element, no 艹), 脩 (in 森脩), 衞 (kyujitai, in 石渡森衞) and 外 (in 屋山外記). A 3x montage settled 吉村土肥, 平岡丹治, 織田泉三, 戸川平太, 妻木務, 岩田綠堂 and 尾崎彌一郎.

MASTER CROSS-CHECK. MASTER carries one row for this page, 静岡藩 兵隊 "(NO military line; large officer corps only)". The scan agrees: there is no 兵隊 / 銃兵 / 炮兵 line anywhere on the leaf, and Shizuoka's entry is officials only and continues onto the next leaf. MASTER has no row at all for 三池藩 here, although Miike's complete councillor establishment — the 七人 summary plus seven named men — is printed on this leaf; that is a gap in MASTER, not a disagreement.

WHAT I DID NOT BOX. No stray ink survived checking: the projection hits at x2165-2225 and x1785-1800 inside the first name register turned out to be the top few rows of 屋 and 中 protruding into the window, not separate marks. No bleed-through, binding-edge or frame ink was boxed.

GEOMETRY. All 38 boxes were cut by ink projection inside per-element windows drawn from the band profiles, padded 10 px, with the pad reduced to 0-3 px where a 公議人 rider sits within a few pixels of the neighbouring name column. A pairwise test reports zero overlaps. Two overlay passes were rendered to _final.png; the first showed two 2-px collisions (rider vs neighbouring name on each side), which were corrected, and the second confirmed every box is flush — label glyph through last value glyph, no clipped strokes, no box on whitespace.

lower_p237_left.page_header_en: Hansei ichiran-hyō, Fascicle 9 (Miike, Shizuoka) — the officials-and-military fascicle of the 1869-70 Dajōkan domain survey. The header names the domains whose entries open on this leaf, not every domain printed on it: Mikusa's tail also runs across the right-hand edge.
lower_p237_left.page_topic: Fascicle-9 domain officials: Miike's whole councillor roster and the opening of Shizuoka's
lower_p237_left.page_summary_en: Printed page 451 of fascicle 9, an officials leaf with no military section. It opens on the right with the tail of Mikusa domain — one 權少參事 column carrying Ishiwata Mori'e and Ozaki Yaichirō — after which the ○三池藩 marker introduces Miike's complete councillor establishment: a summary line 大小參事 七人 (senior and junior councillors, 7 persons) followed by one senior councillor, two acting senior councillors, two junior councillors and two acting junior councillors, seven named men that reconcile exactly with the printed figure; a small-type （一二八人）, 128 persons, stands in the gutter beside it and cannot be a correction to that count. The ○靜岡藩 marker then opens the Tokugawa house's Shizuoka domain with thirteen men in three grades: one senior councillor (Hiraoka Tanji), nine acting senior councillors including Ōkubo Ichiō, Yamaoka Tetsutarō (Tesshū) and the kōgi-nin Tsumaki Tsutomu, and three junior councillors including Tsuda Shin'ichirō, the later jurist Tsuda Mamichi. Shizuoka's entry prints no troop line and runs on to the next leaf.

neighbour_domains.evidence: The single column at x2555-2674 (title 權少參事, names 石渡森衞 and 尾崎彌一郎) stands to the RIGHT of the ○三池藩 marker at x2448-2539, so it belongs to the preceding domain. That domain is Mikusa: the facing leaf lower_p237_right runs the header 藩制一覽表第九（峯岡、三草）and ends with Mikusa's 少參事 column, which continues here.

Miike's five columns (x1728-2420) stand to the RIGHT of the ○靜岡藩 marker at x1622-1716 and to the LEFT of its own ○三池藩 marker at x2448-2539. Its block is complete on this leaf: 大小參事 七人 plus seven named men. The junior councillor 立花碩 bears the surname of Miike's ruling house.

upper_p032_right.page_summary_en: This leaf continues the fascicle-1 return for Iida domain in Shinano, with no domain marker on the page: every figure belongs to Iida. The right-hand block gives the five-year average tax rice for 1864 through 1868 — regular land tax 9,191.7371 koku, miscellaneous land rent 123.14144 koku, and miscellaneous imposts 723.62848 koku, summing exactly to the printed total of 10,038.50702 koku of actual rice. The demographic block records 5,770 households and 26,580 people in the horse-year (1870) count, split 13,383 men and 13,197 women, with a marginal note giving the snake-year (1869) figures of 5,722 households and 26,418 people. The religious and status counts follow: 49 shrines with 11 attendant households (23 men, 19 women), 8 yamabushi households (11 men, 16 women), 52 temples broken down as 36 temples, 12 sub-temples and 4 nunneries with 167 residents (136 men, 31 women including 5 nuns), 208 shizoku houses holding 1,075 people, and 130 sotsu houses holding 504.

The new-field increment row 込高新田 is printed but left blank, so the 753.0341-koku difference between the surveyed and base yields is nowhere stated on the page.

ARITHMETIC NET (this is what confirms items 3-6 character by character): the 雜税金 cash figure, reckoned at 永一貫文 = 金一兩, is 330.35534 ryō. Divided by the printed 八兩立 rate that is 41.2944175 koku of rice. 10,424.9424 + 41.2944 = 10,466.23681 -- exactly the printed 合米 to the 才 place. 8. x 1838-1906 人口 二萬三百八十一人 = 20,381; below it the 内 split prints two side-by-side runs with a clean ink valley at x 1866: 女 九千七百八十五人 (left, 9,785) and 男 一萬五百九十六人 (right, 10,596). 10,596 + 9,785 = 20,381. Checks.

upper_p044_left.page_topic: Niwase land assessment, tax, households and status-group population
upper_p044_left.page_summary_en: This leaf carries the fascicle-1 economic and demographic block for Niwase domain in Bitchū province, a 20,000-koku Itakura holding whose surveyed gross yield (草高) was 20,573.78265 koku. Regular land tax in rice came to 10,424.9424 koku and miscellaneous cash taxes to 330 ryō 355.34 mon; converted at the eight-ryō rate printed in the margin, the two sum exactly to the recorded combined total of 10,466.23681 koku. The domain reported 4,723 households and 20,381 commoners (10,596 male, 9,785 female), and separately 162 shizoku households with 502 persons, 168 sotsu households with 416 persons, 163 eta households with 861 persons, and 19 hinin households (locally called chasen) with 81 persons. Fifty-eight shrines are recorded, staffed by 52 attendants in 19 households; the printed sotsu total of 416 does not match its own male and female components, which sum to 446.

upper_p027_right.reasoning:
MARKERS AND OWNERSHIP. I searched the whole leaf for a maru-marker (circle + name + 藩) and there is none: no ○ glyph appears anywhere between x=420 and x=2280. The page is therefore wholly interior to one domain's block, and the only naming on the leaf is the running header at the far right, 藩制一覽表第一（出石）, which is provenance (fascicle 1, Izushi). MASTER independently assigns the page to 出石藩. Every box below is owned by 出石藩; the right-of-marker / left-of-marker rule never fires here, and there are no neighbour domains to attribute.

TWO TOP-RULE GROUP NOTES. Two bracketed labels sit on the horizontal rule at y≈1031–1094, printed rotated 180° relative to the body text. Rotating them upright they read （十月調） at x 1890–2093 (right) and （十一月調） at x 505–741 (left); ink-projection confirms the left one carries an extra 8-px vertical stroke (一) between 十 and 月 that the right one has no room for (十 at 2017–2061 abuts 月 at 1964–2010). The rule hooks downward at x≈950–1030, so the tenth-month note governs the tax columns to its right (込高 through 銀) and the eleventh-month note governs the household/population columns to its left.

2055–2172 a warichu label split 5+3 — right line 込高新田高, left line 改出高 — over 貳千八百拾八石六斗四升四勺五才 (石6斗4升[合 skipped]4勺5才 = 2,818.64045).

1518–1611 合 壹萬四千五百九拾九石壹斗五升六合貳勺八才 = 14,599.15628 (21 glyph runs).
1413–1485 雜税 heading. 1253–1343 米 四百六拾七石壹斗壹升五合六勺四才 = 467.11564. 1133–1215 大豆 拾石五斗貳升三合五勺 = 10.5235. 994–1085 銀 五拾四貫五百九拾貳匁七分七厘, with a two-line warichu below at 970–1076 (right line 金一兩ニ付銀, left line 百匁之相場).

正租: 12,911.65508 + 1,687.5012 = 14,599.15628, exactly the printed 合. 人口: 16,286 + 15,915 = 32,201. 番人: 105 + 92 = 197. 茶筅: 86 + 106 = 192.

The printed total settles it: 12,911.65508 + 1,687.5012 = 14,599.15628 matches the printed 合 to the last digit, whereas MASTER's 1,687.5152 would give 14,599.17028. upper_p027_right.page_summary_en: This leaf is the fascicle-one entry for Izushi domain (出石藩) in Tajima, printed on book page 28. It records an included yield (込高) of 2,818.64045 koku from new fields and reassessment; a regular land tax (正租) averaged over the five years Ansei 6 (1859) to Bunkyū 3 (1863) of 12,911.65508 koku of rice and 1,687.5012 koku of soybeans, whose printed total 14,599.15628 koku reconciles exactly; and miscellaneous taxes (雜税) of 467.11564 koku of rice, 10.5235 koku of soybeans, and 54 kan 592 monme 7 fun 7 rin of silver, reckoned at the rate of 100 monme of silver to one ryō of gold. The demographic block gives 7,076 households and 32,201 people (16,286 male, 15,915 female) for town and countryside together, and then counts two occupational groups separately: 42 watchman (番人) households with 197 people, and 42 tea-whisk-maker (茶筅) households with 192 people. Rules across the head of the page date the tax columns to a tenth-month return and the household and population columns to an eleventh-month return.

upper_p041_right.page_header_en: Domain Survey (藩制一覽表), Fascicle 1 — running head printed for Hayashida (林田). The head names the domain whose block opens on this leaf; the data on the leaf is almost entirely Hakata's (伯太藩).
upper_p041_right.page_topic: Civil register: cash tax and rice equivalents, households, population, and non-commoner status groups
upper_p041_right.page_summary_en: This leaf closes the fascicle-1 civil register of Hakata domain (伯太藩), a 13,500-koku Watanabe holding in Izumi province whose block opened on the facing earlier page. It records a miscellaneous tax in gold of 43 ryō 1 bu 3 shu plus 53.18 mon in ei-cash, its rice equivalent of 5.4363 koku, and a combined current-rice total (合現石) of 6,073.2917 koku, against 2,109 households and a population of 10,439. Below the commoner figures the page breaks out the non-commoner groups: 149 samurai and sotsu households (86 shizoku, 63 sotsu) holding 615 people, an outcast (穢多) group of 71 households and 294 people split evenly at 147 men and 147 women, 82 shrines with 8 shrine-attendant households and 22 people, 76 temples with 131 people, and 75 villages. The last column belongs to the next domain: the ○林田藩 marker opens Hayashida's block with an assessed yield (草高) of 14,889.6719 koku. Two totals do not close as printed — the male-plus-female split of the population falls 294 short of the printed 10,439 (exactly the outcast count), and the status breakdown of the 615 samurai-class people sums to 574.

The running header names （新谷）, which agrees with the marked domain rather than with the tail block — provenance, not attribution.

That triple agreement confirms all six digits and shows the 768 is entirely retainer households (shizoku plus sotsu), not the whole domain population. MASTER has dropped the 合 and the 七 that follows it. I have recorded the scan reading.

NOT BOXED: two isolated specks (approx x1133/y3011 and x1650/y3830), the dark binding shadow at the right edge, and the scan frame.

GEOMETRY. Boxes were cut by ink projection per column (threshold px<120, first..last inked row/col) with roughly 8 px padding, then checked programmatically for pairwise overlap — one 1-px collision between the 寺 and 神社 boxes was removed by trimming 寺 to width 120. upper_p046_right.page_topic: Kokudaka, rice and soybean taxes, population, temples, shrines and troops
upper_p046_right.page_summary_en: This half-leaf, printed book page 66 of Hansei ichiran fascicle 1, closes the entry for 西大路藩 (Nishi-ōji, Ōmi) and opens the entry for 新谷藩 (Niiya, Iyo). For Nishi-ōji it records a retainer population of 768 (379 male, 389 female), split into 352 shizoku and 416 sotsu; 40 outcaste (eta) households holding 171 persons; 56 shrines served by 10 households and 41 persons; 50 temples with 86 monks and 27 women; 29 villages; and two platoons totalling 80 men including officers. The maru-marker ○新谷藩 then opens Niiya, which returns a gross assessed yield (草高) of 9,692.67578 koku against a rated kokudaka (高) of 10,000 koku, a rice tax (正税米) of 3,824.2028 koku, and — under a 諸雜税 heading annotated as a five-year average from the Meiji 2 kishi-year survey — 1,295.40188 koku of soybeans, converted to rice at 80 percent as 1,036.3215 koku. Two figures need flagging: the eta counts sum to 172 against a printed total of 171, an inconsistency in the source itself, and the 草高 printed here carries a 五合七勺 that the project's MASTER row omits.

The running head is PROVENANCE: it names 新見 because 新見藩's block opens on this leaf; it does not mean every column here is Niimi's.

(2) x 1994-2094, y 1131-3058 — 寺院　五十九寺（僧六十二人　外ニ　山伏五戸　五人）. The opening paren prints as a wide arc over 僧; the closing arc sits under the final 人 at y≈3040-3058. 外ニ is small type, right-offset.

(4) x 1741-1830, y 1468-2009 — the MARU-MARKER: ○ (1468-1547), 新 (1577-1657), 見 (1755-1834), 藩 (1927-2010). This is the only marker on the leaf.

DOMAIN BOUNDARY. The right-to-left rule puts everything RIGHT of the ○新見藩 marker with the PREVIOUS domain and everything LEFT of it with 新見藩. So columns (2) 寺院 and (3) 兵隊 are the tail of the preceding domain's fascicle-1 block, which in fascicle 1 ends on 寺院 then 兵隊 — exactly the ordering seen here. The preceding domain is 庭瀬藩 (Niwase, Bitchū): MASTER carries 庭瀬藩's fascicle-1 草高 on pdf_page 44, immediately before this leaf, and 新谷藩/西大路藩 come after. Independent confirmation from the dataset: MASTER's fascicle-8 military row for 庭瀬藩 reads 「二小隊　一小隊六十人」 = 120 men, which is the same force as the 兵隊 column here (二小隊, 六十名一小隊); 新見藩's own military is quite different (常備兵隊 75人 / 豫備歩兵 60人 / 豫備砲兵 19人). So the 寺院 and 兵隊 boxes are owned by 庭瀬藩, and the header column plus book-page number are page furniture assigned to the leaf's primary domain, 新見藩.

(5) x 1607-1697, y 1126-2619 — 草高　壹萬八千百九十六石一斗四升二勺. Fifteen glyph runs after the two label glyphs; 八 verified splayed-and-separate (not 人/入), 千 verified with the slanted stroke on top (not 十), 六 verified with its top lid. = 18,196.1402 koku. Matches MASTER exactly.

upper_p045_right.page_summary_en: This right-hand leaf (printed page 64) opens the fascicle-one entry for Niimi Domain in Bitchū Province, marked by the circle-marker ○新見藩 in the middle of the leaf. Niimi's assessed kokudaka (草高) is 18,196.1402 koku, of which 196.1402 koku is recorded separately as an added increment from newly reclaimed fields (込高新田), averaged over five years — leaving the domain's nominal 18,000-koku assessment exactly. The regular land tax came in at 5,731.4909 koku of rice plus 2,204 ryō 2 bu 1 shu and 32.5 mon in cash, the cash portion being valued at a further 440.919 koku of rice at the stated rate of 5 ryō per koku; miscellaneous taxes added 296.7454 koku of rice, 291 ryō 1 bu 3 shu and 19.4 mon, and a further 58 ryō from ironworks, blacksmiths and livestock markets that the entry notes varies from year to year. The domain counted 124 shizoku households (592 people: 312 male, 280 female) and 217 sotsu households (612 people: 330 male, 282 female). The two columns to the right of the marker — 59 temples with 62 monks plus 5 yamabushi households, and a force of two companies at 60 men each — are the tail of the preceding domain's entry and belong to Niwase Domain.

upper_p045_left.page_summary_en: This left half-leaf (printed page 65) carries the end of Niimi han's fascicle-1 return and the start of Nishiōji han's. Right of the ○西大路藩 marker, Niimi's figures run: a combined samurai subtotal of 341 households and 1,204 people (642 male, 562 female), which matches the 124 shizoku and 217 sotsu households printed on the facing page; a domain total of 3,071 households and 15,126 people (7,904 male, 7,222 female); 132 outcaste (eta) households with 594 people; 22 villages; 181 shrines with 41 shrine-servant households totalling 203 people; 63 temples with 71 monks and 10 nuns; and 8 Shugendō households with 31 people. Left of the marker, Nishiōji's entry opens with a nominal assessed yield of 17,004.5 koku, a supplementary yield of 39.1725 koku, a five-year-average land tax of 6,862 koku, and 2,261 households with 9,106 people, of which 225 samurai-class households. The parenthetical breakdown of that last figure — 85 shizoku and 125 sotsu households — sums to 210 rather than 225, a discrepancy printed in the source itself.

neighbour_domains.evidence: Every column right of the ○西大路藩 marker (x>1803) continues Niimi's entry from the facing right half-leaf (printed p. 64), whose header reads 藩制一覽表第一（新見）and whose marker is ○新見藩. The 合 column at the right edge here (341 households, 1,204 people, 642 male, 562 female) is exactly the sum of Niimi's 士族戸數 百二十四戸／人口五百九十二人（男三百十二人 女二百八十人）and 卒族戸數 二百十七戸／人口六百十二人（男三百三十人 女二百八十二人）printed on p. 64.

upper_p047_right.reasoning:
MARKER SURVEY. Ink-projection over the paper area (x 200-2450, y 900-3500) returned 14 vertical column bands. Exactly ONE maru-marker is printed on the leaf: ○西端藩 at x 2009-2100, y 1462-2002. It is the RIGHTMOST inked element of the text block; the only things standing to its right are the running header column (x 2157-2220, y 1380-1940, reading 藩制一覽表第一（西端）) and the printed book-page number 六十八 (x 2125-2175, y 3229-3370). The running header names 西端 as well, so provenance and data agree here.

1. (2126-2220) running header 藩制一覽表第一（西端）at y 1380-1940, and lower in the same band the book-page number 六十八 at y 3229-3370. Non-data.

10. (947-1025) label read at 9x on a single-glyph crop: 金 radical + 亞 = 鐚 (bita-sen). Value 二貫八百四十二文 = 2,842 mon.
11. (816-890) 錢 五貫六百九十文 = 5,690 mon.

(a) Population: 6,356 + 6,086 = 12,442 = the printed 人口 total. RECONCILES exactly, which also confirms the 人/八/入 readings in both sub-runs.
(b) Hinin: 11 + 12 = 23 = the printed 非人人口 total. RECONCILES.

upper_p047_right.page_topic: Nishibata domain land assessment, tax yield, households and population
upper_p047_right.page_summary_en: Printed page 68 of fascicle 1 of the Hansei ichiran-hyō, given over entirely to Nishibata domain in Mikawa province; the single maru-marker ○西端藩 opens the block and no other domain appears on the leaf. The survey records a gross assessed yield (草高) of 14,008.75433 koku against an official kokudaka (高) of 10,500 koku, with newly opened and re-surveyed land (込高・新田・改出高) accounting for 3,508.9994 koku. The domain counted 2,599 households and 12,442 people (6,356 male, 6,086 female), of whom 5 households and 23 people (11 male, 12 female) were registered as hinin.

For Nishi-Ōhira it records 28 shrines and 51 temples; 61 shizoku households (with 2 more noted apart) holding 237 people (117 male, 120 female); 10 sotsu households holding 40 people (18 male, 22 female); 28 villages; no eta; 21 shrine officiants (13 male, 8 female) and 246 Buddhist clergy (111 male, 135 female). Two temple endowments follow: Myōgon-ji with a grant of 45 koku yielding 3.09917 koku of land-tax rice and 21 ryō 2 bu 3 shu plus 50.417 ei-mon in cash, and Sanmyō-ji with a grant of 20 koku yielding 7.324 koku. Left of the maru-marker ○本庄藩 the page gives Honjō's kusadaka as 27,223.061 koku, of which 7,164.255 koku is entered as newly opened field and paddy, together with a note that the figures continuing overleaf are five-year averages running from Kōshi (1864) to Boshin (1868).

Note the source's own inconsistent counters — the total and 卒 are given in 軒, 士族 in 戸; I preserved each verbatim.

WHERE THE SCAN CONTRADICTS MASTER. MASTER has this leaf's contents filed under "upper 100 L" (正租 米, 戸數, 士族戸數, 卒, and the four 産物 items) and files 人口 三萬三千三百九十九人 under "upper 100 R". The scan says otherwise: every one of those "100 L" fields is printed HERE on 100 R, and there is no 人口 column anywhere on this leaf — the population figure must sit on the facing left half-leaf. MASTER's left/right sides for pdf_page 100 are swapped. I trusted the scan. Two smaller MASTER slips confirmed off the image: the paper note's verb is 漉出 (氵+鹿, "to make paper"), not 瀧出; and the 産物 和紙 / 漆 notes use ノ, which MASTER transcribed as ニ.

GEOMETRY. All fifteen boxes measured by threshold-at-120 ink projection with ~10 px padding, reduced to ~7 px on the one tight pair (the parenthetical at x1606-1687 against the 但 note at x1702-1800, a 15 px gutter). A programmatic pairwise test reported zero overlaps. One overlay render was enough: every box is flush on its glyph run, none clips a glyph, none sits on whitespace, and the faint facing-page bleed-through in the left-centre of the leaf is left unboxed.

upper_p100_right.page_summary_en: This half-leaf continues the Kaminoyama Domain entry in fascicle 3 of the 1870 Hansei ichiran; it carries no maru-marker, so every column belongs to the domain whose marker stands on the preceding leaf. The regular land tax (正租), stated as a five-year average, is 10,487.166 koku of rice reckoned in actual koku, with a note that 804 kan 64 mon 2 bu of miscellaneous cash taxes were converted at eight ryō per koku and folded into that figure — and a compiler's parenthetical warning that regular and miscellaneous tax are mixed and the number is printed as it stands. Four products follow: ōbōshi and washi paper joined by a brace (about 2,000 ryō made per year), raw silk (about 1,200 kanme by thread weight, varying with the year), ramie (about 500 ryō), and lacquer (about 600 ryō), with the tax rules on all four deferred for later inquiry. The leaf closes with 5,570 households, of which 122 are shizoku and 147 sotsu.

upper_p049_left.reasoning:
SCAN 3094x4551. Ink-projection over y=900..3600, x=600..2950 gives 14 vertical glyph runs, which resolve (after sub-band projection of the merged run 1713-1920) into 20 discrete elements. Right-to-left walk:

(1) x2661-2733, y1089-1650: 神社　九拾壹社. (2) x2523-2601, y1086-2092: （知事家族不記　船艦不所持）. (3) x2382-2463, y1088-1734: 銃士　百九十七人; (4) same column, y1844-2577: 兵卒　二百三十五人 — two fields stacked in one column separated by a 110px blank, so two boxes. (5) x2239-2327, y1430-1969: the ONLY maru-marker on the page, ○堀江藩, set lower than its neighbours as HI markers always are.

DOMAIN BOUNDARY: the marker at x2239-2327 starts 堀江藩. Everything to its RIGHT (elements 1-4) is read earlier and belongs to the PREVIOUS domain; everything to its LEFT (elements 6-18) belongs to 堀江藩. The previous domain is 本庄藩 (Honjō): HI_pdf_bookmark_index.csv places 本荘藩 at Vol1 pdf p.48 and 堀江藩 at p.49 with nothing between them, and I opened upper_p048_left myself — it carries ○本庄藩 (printed 本庄, not the canonical 本荘), the running header 藩制一覧表第一（本庄）, and printed page 七十一 (71). Our page prints 七十三 (73), so book p.72 (pdf p.49 right, absent from the viewer image set) plus the three columns right of our marker complete the Honjō entry. The trailing fields that spill right of the next marker here are exactly the ones the project's vol1 overflow note predicts for fascicle 1 (神社 and the 兵-class counts), so the attribution follows the standard rule rather than an exception.

Running header (element 19, x925-989, y1345-1901) reads 藩制一覽表第一（堀江） — provenance, and here it names the same domain as the page's data. The printed book page 七十三 (element 20) sits in the same column at y3186-3329.

堀江藩 block, right to left: (6) 草高壹萬六石 = 10,006; zoomed at 4x, 六 carries the 亠 lid so it is 6 not 8, and this agrees with MASTER's 壹萬六石 / 10006. (7) x1926-2057: 内 at the head of the column, then （新田改出共　現高五千四百八十四石七斗八合三勺八才）. Per instructions the structural 内 is not boxed on its own; it is enclosed in this box, which it heads. Sub-units run 石 > 斗 > [升 skipped] > 合 > 勺 > 才, strictly descending, so 5,484.70838; I re-zoomed 八合三勺八才 at 3x to rule out 八升. (8) x1834-1924: （村々見込追々開墾地高四千五百二十一石二斗一升一合六勺二才） = 4,521.21162. (9) x1784-1834, small type set higher than its neighbours (top y1152): the warichu 甲子ヨリ戊辰年五ヶ年平均, introducing the revenue figures to its left. (10) x1705-1783: 正租米千七百九拾貳石貳升三合貳勺九才 — the 斗 place is skipped and 貳升 is confirmed at 2.6x, giving 1,792.02329. (11) 延米三百八拾八石壹斗八升三合九才 = 388.18309. (12) x1518-1572, a short small-type column: （麥賣出シ代）, qualifying the cash figure immediately to its left. (13) 永七百拾八貫三百貳文七分四厘 = 718.30274 kanmon. (14) 此米八拾九石七斗八升七合八勺四才 = 89.78784, with (15) its warichu 卽麥賣出シ永八兩立 below in smaller type — main type spans x1307-1382 down to y2670, the note narrows to x1319-1367 from y2693, so the split is clean. (16) 雜税金拾貳兩貳分壹朱永百四拾九文壹分六厘, main type ending y2832, with (17) its two-column warichu 此米壹石六斗貳升貳勺七五 beginning y2856. (18) 合現米貳千貳百七拾壹石六斗壹升四合四勺貳才七五 = 2,271.6144275.

ARITHMETIC NET, three checks run:
(a) 現高 5,484.70838 + 開墾地高 4,521.21162 = 10,005.92000 against 草高 10,006. The fractional parts cancel exactly (.70838 + .21162 = .92000), which is strong evidence both sub-figures are read correctly; the source itself falls 0.08 koku short of its own 草高. I re-zoomed both tails rather than adjust a digit to force the sum.
(b) The 八兩立 conversion: 718.30274 kanmon of ei-cash at 1 kanmon = 1 ryō, divided by 8 ryō per koku, = 89.7878425, printed as 此米 89.78784. This independently confirms the 永 figure, the 此米 figure and the warichu together.
(c) 正租米 1,792.02329 + 延米 388.18309 + 此米 89.78784 + 雜税此米 1.620275 = 2,271.614495 against the printed 合現米 2,271.6144275 — agreement to five decimal places, leaving 0.0000675 koku, which is rounding inside the source's own conversions, not a misread digit.
The 雜税 conversion does not reconcile at the same 8-ryō rate: 12 ryō 2 bu 1 shu = 12.5625 ryō, plus 149.16 mon = 12.71166 ryō, which at 8 ryō per koku gives 1.5890 rather than the printed 1.620275. The HI applies a different rate to the miscellaneous taxes, so I recorded the printed figures without adjusting either.

BOX GEOMETRY: every box was measured by thresholding px<120 and taking the first..last inked row and column within its band, then padded about 8px — reduced to 2-4px where adjacent columns are only 7-9px apart (村々 / warichu, 延米 / 麥賣出シ代, 麥賣出シ代 / 永). A residual-ink sweep over the whole text area (x880-2790, y1000-3700) leaves 54 uncovered pixels, all faint edge strokes at the 正租米 / warichu seam. A pairwise overlap test across all 20 boxes returns zero overlaps. Nothing else is printed on the leaf: no 但 subtext, no absence markers beyond element 2, and no bleed-through dark enough to box. One overlay pass was rendered and read; no box clipped a glyph or sat on whitespace, so no second pass was needed.
upper_p049_left.page_topic: Horie domain kokudaka composition and 1864-68 average tax revenue
upper_p049_left.page_summary_en: The left half of pdf page 49 (printed page 73) opens with the last three fields of the preceding entry, Honjō domain (本庄藩): 91 shrines, a note that the governor's family was not recorded and that the domain held no warships, and a force of 197 riflemen and 235 rank-and-file soldiers, all printed to the right of the ○堀江藩 marker and therefore belonging to Honjō. Everything left of the marker is Horie domain (堀江藩) in Tōtōmi, whose nominal kusadaka of 10,006 koku is itemised on this leaf as 5,484.70838 koku of present assessed yield (including newly opened fields re-entered on the register) and 4,521.21162 koku of village land the domain merely expected to bring under cultivation by degrees. The revenue block, explicitly a five-year average from 1864 to 1868, records 1,792.02329 koku of regular land tax rice, a 388.18309 koku nobemai surcharge, 718 kan 302.74 mon of ei-cash from barley sales converted at 8 ryō per koku to 89.78784 koku, and miscellaneous taxes of 12 ryō 2 bu 1 shu plus 149.16 mon converted to 1.620275 koku. Those four items sum to the printed total of 2,271.6144275 koku of current rice, matching the components to five decimal places.

Measurements: the stroke is at x1243-1292, y1433-1444, 50 px wide against 62-64 px for a full-size 一 and 44 px for the parenthesised correction glyphs on p405; it sits in the gap between the 權大參事 and 大參事 columns, i.e. the right-side annotation slot for 權大參事. No parentheses print around it (checked at thresholds 120/150/175/200 and at 12x). p405 settles what the device means: there 大參事 三人 carries （四人） and has four names (松平方, 秋田豐, 小笠原幹, 村田巳三郎, filling its own column and the next), and 少參事 七人 carries （五） and has five names, after which 權少參事's names restart in its own heading column. The corrective figure equals the true count in both cases. So Fukuyama's 權大參事 establishment is 1, not 2. I have echoed parsed=2 (the survey's own printed figure) rather than overwrite it, because that is a project convention question; if the dataset should carry the operative count, set parsed=1.

Eight men are named in the four office columns to the left: two senior councillors (屋山外記, 庵原覺平), two acting senior councillors (佐野三郎治, 森脩), two junior councillors (立花碩, 吉村土肥) and two acting junior councillors (中島裕, 堀七右衞門). A small-type parenthetical （一二八人）is set in the gutter immediately to the right of the figure and is recorded here verbatim. Its second glyph is graphically identical to the katakana ニ, so the gloss may be the reprint editor's correction 「一ニ八人」 (one text has eight persons), which would match the eight names exactly; read as digits it is 128 persons for something this leaf does not name. The leaf alone does not settle which.
verdicts.issue: TRANSCRIPTION VERIFIED but the proposal's ARITHMETIC IS WRONG. Glyph checks: 小 (three strokes, no falling stroke) not 少, confirmed at 6x against the 少 of the 少參事 titles; 七 confirmed (crossbar + hooked leg, not 十/九); the parenthetical is （一二八人）with 一 at y1489-1498 (single long stroke), 二 at y1525-1560 (short stroke over long), 八 at y1575-1618 and 人 at y1626-1669, the closing bracket at y1672-1691. Character cells run on a 51px pitch, which rules out reading the three horizontals as 三. The 八 was checked stroke-for-stroke against the known 八 of 淺野次郎八 on this same leaf: in this face 八's right stroke carries a heavy serif head that extends left and reads as a horizontal bar, so the glyph is 八, not 六. WHAT IS WRONG: the proposal's reasoning field, this box's English, the 三池權少參事 box's English and the page_summary_en all state that seven men are named ("1 + 2 + 2 + 2 = 7") and that the figure reconciles. Eight men are named — every one of the four Miike office columns carries two names, verified from the two name registers (y2044-2632 and y2968-3555). The page-level summary and reasoning need the same correction: Miike's establishment as printed on this leaf is eight named men against a summary line of 七人, and the parenthetical cannot be dismissed as unrelated to that count.
